name: Piecewise Hermite Color Transfer Function
definition: A color mapping technique that uses modified piecewise Hermite functions to interpolate RGB or HSV values between user-defined nodes, supporting interpolation ranging from piecewise constant to piecewise linear.
summary: The Piecewise Hermite Color Transfer Function maps scalar values to RGB colors using modified Hermite interpolation, distinguished by midpoint and sharpness parameters that control non-linear blending curves.
